summary: Stellantis N.V. furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release announcing that its Third Quarter 2026 financial results will be released on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. A live audio webcast and conference call is scheduled for 1:00 p.m. CET / 8:00 a.m. EDT that day, with press release and presentation materials expected to be posted in the Investors section of the corporate website at approximately 8:00 a.m. CET / 3:00 a.m. EDT. No special-situation transaction, terms, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. Monitoring the earnings release for guidance and any strategic updates is the relevant follow-up.
